arguments.content: Recovery retry review pattern: an 'applied' checkpoint is insufficient to skip replacement on retry when incomplete-operation retries may change payload. Receipt failure can leave a previously applied payload behind; a successful retry must converge active state and recovery payload to the latest submission before completion. Validate changed-value retries across the apply/receipt failure boundary; distinguish them from retries of already completed IDs. Observed P1 in service.py save.
